name: RPLIDAR S2
description: Long-range 360° DTOF LiDAR: 30 m (10 m on black), 32 kHz at 10 Hz, ±30 mm, works in 80 klux sunlight, IP65. For outdoor and larger mobile robots that need dense scans at range.

variants.note: Standard UART S2 (S2M1-R2). XH2.54-5P: VCC, TX, RX, GND, NC (ground recommended). S2L (18 m), S2P (50 m) and S2E (Ethernet, 12 V) are separate models

kicad.footprintNote: Ready-made module: wire it up with a connector or header

notes: DTOF, 905 nm, IEC-60825 Class 1. Range 0.05–30 m on 90% white, 0.05–10 m on 10% black.
UART 1 Mbaud 8N1, 3.3 V TTL. Kit includes a USB adapter, but the sensor itself has no USB.
Single 4.9–5.2 V supply: 500 mA typ (600 max) at 10 Hz, 1.5 A at start-up.
No motor pin. Speed is set by serial command.
Datasheet: 0.12° angular resolution at 10 Hz; product page: 0.1125°. Accuracy ±30 mm typical, 13 mm resolution (90% target).
80 klux ambient-light figure is from the product page. IP65, 0–50 °C (datasheet; the web page says -10 to 50 °C).
Weight 185 g per datasheet (190 g on spec page). ROS/ROS2 via rplidar_ros.
